_comment: command-structure.json — the ORDER of fields for each 'set <object>' command.
Format: Each key is an object type, value is an array of field names in order.
Reorder a command by moving field names in the array. That is all you edit here.
Everything else (which fields are choices, the choices themselves, the hints,
which are required) comes from the API/field library in code — never this file.
You do NOT need quotes around values with spaces — ARC works out where each
field ends from the structure below (quotes still work for rare edge cases).
Keys starting with _ are instructions/metadata and are ignored by the parser.
